title: psychotria rufocalyx
intro: Psychotria rufocalyx, commonly known as the Red-haired Wild Coffee, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. Research has shown that this plant possesses several health benefits, including its potential to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Psychotria rufocalyx include alkaloids and phenolic compounds, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic and anti-hyperglycemic effects. However, further studies are needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Psychotria rufocalyx as a medicinal plant.
